entities.summary: Thomas Kurzhals (b. 1953-12-13, Ronneburg) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ronneburg and Germany. Known in the fields of germany, composers & musicians, europe.
